packs.name: jdk
packs.about: Java 21, which Gradle, sdkmanager and the emulator tools need. The first thing a node needs for Android work.
packs.label: JDK 21 (Temurin)

packs.name: android-tools
packs.about: sdkmanager and avdmanager, through which every other Android toolchain installs. Sets this node's ANDROID_HOME.
packs.label: Android command-line tools

packs.name: android-cmake
packs.about: The CMake the NDK's build system uses.
packs.label: Android CMake
packs.online: sdkmanager downloads this package from dl.google.com and checks it against Google's own listing

packs.name: android-emulator
packs.about: The Android emulator. Its system images, one per API level, are added on the Emulator tab. Google ships it for x86_64 Linux only.
packs.label: Android emulator
packs.online: sdkmanager downloads this package from dl.google.com and checks it against Google's own listing

packs.name: android-platform-tools
packs.about: adb and the other tools that talk to a phone or an emulator; the emulator and the Phone tab need it. Google ships it for x86_64 Linux only.
packs.label: Android platform tools
packs.online: sdkmanager downloads this package from dl.google.com and checks it against Google's own listing

packs.name: android-platforms
packs.about: The android.jar a build compiles against (compileSdk), at the newest level Google publishes. Update adds the next level beside it, so older projects keep building. Removing this removes every level.
packs.label: Android SDK Platform (newest level)
packs.online: sdkmanager downloads this package from dl.google.com and checks it against Google's own listing

packs.name: android-build-tools
packs.about: aapt2, d8, zipalign and apksigner at the newest stable version. Update adds the next beside it.
packs.label: Android SDK Build-Tools (newest)
packs.online: sdkmanager downloads this package from dl.google.com and checks it against Google's own listing

packs.name: android-ndk
packs.about: Native development kit, for C and C++ inside an Android app.
packs.label: Android NDK
packs.online: sdkmanager downloads this package from dl.google.com and checks it against Google's own listing

packs.name: flutter
packs.about: Flutter with its Dart SDK. Builds Android apps on Linux, and iOS too on a Mac with Xcode.
packs.label: Flutter
packs.online: its first run downloads the Dart SDK and its engine from storage.googleapis.com, and its packages from pub.dev

packs.name: go
packs.about: Go, which cross-compiles to Windows, macOS, Linux and ARM with nothing else to install.
packs.label: Go

packs.name: dotnet
packs.about: The .NET SDK plus the maui-android workload: Android apps from C#.
packs.label: .NET + MAUI
packs.online: dotnet downloads the maui-android workload from api.nuget.org

packs.name: node
packs.about: Node.js and npm, for a project built with npm and for anything that drives a browser with Playwright.
packs.label: Node.js

packs.name: python
packs.about: uv and a Python 3.12 with pip and venv, for a project's own dependencies: uv venv, then uv pip install -r requirements.txt. The node's own python3 has neither.
packs.label: Python (uv)
packs.online: uv downloads the Python 3.12 interpreter from GitHub and checks it against the sha256 uv carries for it

packs.name: playwright
packs.about: Chromium, Firefox and WebKit with the module that drives them, for aerie capture shot and browser tests. Needs node.
packs.label: Playwright browsers
packs.online: Playwright downloads its Chromium, Firefox and WebKit builds from cdn.playwright.dev, and nothing here checks them

packs.name: lint-tools
packs.about: What aerie lint runs: shellcheck, hadolint, actionlint and ruff, with yq and fd. Without it, aerie lint on a node skips its checks.
packs.label: Lint tools (shellcheck, hadolint, actionlint, ruff, yq, fd)

packs.name: ffmpeg
packs.about: ffmpeg, ffprobe and ffplay, for cutting, converting and sizing video and audio, and for turning a recording into frames a session can look at.
packs.label: FFmpeg (video and audio)

packs.name: audio
packs.about: What aerie tool sound say and hear run: piper turns text into speech, and whisper turns a recording back into text with its times. About 800 MB.
packs.label: Speech in and out (piper, whisper)

packs.name: pytorch
packs.about: PyTorch with CUDA, numpy and ONNX, run as python-ml, for training or running a model on the node's NVIDIA card (driver 580 or newer); without a card it runs on the CPU. About 6 GB.
packs.label: PyTorch with CUDA (python-ml, numpy, ONNX)

packs.name: graphics
packs.about: What aerie tool graphics runs: ImageMagick for resizing, cropping and comparing images, resvg for SVG to PNG, and oxipng, pngquant and cwebp for shrinking what an app ships.
packs.label: Graphics tools (ImageMagick, resvg, oxipng, pngquant, cwebp)

packs.name: diagrams
packs.about: What aerie tool diagrams runs: PlantUML and Mermaid, diagrams drawn from text. Needs jdk and playwright beside it.
packs.label: Diagram renderers (PlantUML, Mermaid)

packs.name: documents
packs.about: What aerie tool docs runs: reads a PDF, Word document, slide deck or spreadsheet as Markdown, draws a PDF's pages as pictures, and converts with pandoc. Also lets Claude Code read PDFs. About 650 MB.
packs.label: Document readers (markitdown, PyMuPDF, pandoc)

packs.name: office
packs.about: What aerie tool office runs: LibreOffice without a window, to turn documents, decks and spreadsheets into PDFs. About 750 MB.
packs.label: LibreOffice, headless

packs.name: ftp
packs.about: The server behind a project's File access setting: FTPS on the project's node, where people sign in with their own AerieOS name and password. About 60 MB.
packs.label: File access server (FTPS)

packs.name: language-servers
packs.about: Python and TypeScript language servers, so a session sees type errors as it edits rather than at the next build.
packs.label: Language servers (Python, TypeScript)

packs.name: kotlin-lsp
packs.about: JetBrains' Kotlin language server, so a session sees Kotlin errors as it edits. Carries its own Java.
packs.label: Kotlin language server

packs.name: rust
packs.about: rustup, cargo and the stable toolchain. Building for Windows also needs a linker: mingw, or zig with cargo-zigbuild.
packs.label: Rust
packs.online: rustup downloads the stable toolchain from static.rust-lang.org and checks each file against its channel's list

packs.name: swift
packs.about: The Swift toolchain for Linux: shared logic, server-side Swift, and compiling packages. Not an iOS SDK.
packs.label: Swift

packs.name: zig
packs.about: Zig, and a C and C++ cross-compiler (zig cc) for Windows, macOS and Linux; it also links Rust for those.
packs.label: Zig

packs.name: xcodes
packs.about: Installs and switches Xcode versions on a Mac: run xcodes install --latest on the node, with an Apple ID the first time.
packs.label: xcodes (Xcode installer)

packs.name: claude
packs.about: Claude Code, run by sessions as claude
packs.label: Claude
packs.online: Its installer downloads the Claude Code program for this machine from downloads.claude.ai and checks it against the sha256 that release's manifest states; the program then sets up its own launcher.

packs.name: codex
packs.about: Codex CLI, run by sessions as codex
packs.label: ChatGPT
packs.online: Its installer downloads the Codex CLI package for this machine from releases.openai.com or github.com/openai/codex's releases, and checks it against the sha256 GitHub states for that release.

packs.name: copilot
packs.about: Copilot CLI, run by sessions as copilot
packs.label: Copilot

packs.name: grok
packs.about: Grok Build, run by sessions as grok
packs.label: Grok

packs.name: open
packs.about: OpenCode, run by sessions as opencode
packs.label: Any model
packs.online: Its installer downloads the OpenCode build for this machine from github.com/anomalyco/opencode's releases, and checks it against nothing.

packs.name: model-router
packs.about: LiteLLM on this node holding your provider keys, Ollama beside it where you turn it on, offered to the spaces you allow: each is handed its address and a key of its own at a session's start, so its spend is its own. What Start's Any model runs through.
packs.label: Model router

packs.name: nginx
packs.about: nginx on this node in front of its containers: a hostname routed to a container's port, with a certificate of your own or one from Let's Encrypt kept renewed. Its routes and certificates are on its own page, opened from Installed.

packs.name: scanners
packs.about: The scanners on this node, run over the spaces it holds on a schedule or when asked: what each found is on the space's notebook. Their schedule and their runs are on their own page, opened from Installed.
packs.label: Scanners

packs.name: whoami
packs.about: A tiny web server that answers with the hostname, the address and the headers of the request: the simplest container to prove a deploy with.

packs.name: gemini
packs.about: Google's coding agent, Antigravity CLI (agy), as a session's agent beside the ones AerieOS ships: handed the briefing and held by the same guards through its own hooks. It signs in with a Google account, from its page or in its own terminal, or runs on a Gemini API key.
packs.label: Gemini

packs.name: homeassistant
packs.about: Home automation. It runs on the machine's own network so it finds the devices around it, and reaches Bluetooth through the machine's dbus.
packs.label: Home Assistant

packs.name: immich
packs.about: Photos and videos backed up from every phone, with faces, places and search, on a database and a model of its own beside it.
packs.label: Immich

packs.name: jellyfin
packs.about: A media server: films, series and music streamed to every screen, with apps for phones, televisions and browsers and no account anywhere else.
packs.label: Jellyfin

packs.name: plex
packs.about: A media server with Plex's apps and account: films, series and music on every screen. Claim it with a token from plex.tv/claim, or on its first open.
packs.label: Plex

packs.name: sonarr
packs.about: Watches for the series you follow, sends each episode to a download client and files it in your library. It reaches Prowlarr and qBittorrent at this machine's address and their ports.
packs.label: Sonarr

packs.name: radarr
packs.about: Watches for the films you want, sends each to a download client and files it in your library. It reaches Prowlarr and qBittorrent at this machine's address and their ports.
packs.label: Radarr

packs.name: prowlarr
packs.about: Keeps the indexers Sonarr and Radarr search, in one place, and hands them to each at its address on this machine and its port.
packs.label: Prowlarr

packs.name: seerr
packs.about: The request page for a media library: a person asks for a film or a series and it goes to Radarr or Sonarr. It reaches them and Jellyfin or Plex at this machine's address.
packs.label: Seerr

packs.name: nextcloud
packs.about: Files, calendars and contacts with its apps, on a database of its own. Its admin account is made as it first starts.
packs.label: Nextcloud

packs.name: paperclip
packs.about: A company of AI agents as an org chart, each with a role, a budget and approvals, on the model router's key. AerieOS's guards do not reach its agents: its container and its own budgets do.
packs.label: Paperclip

packs.name: qbittorrent
packs.about: A download client with a web page. Its first password is in its log; change it on its first open.
packs.label: qBittorrent

packs.name: syncthing
packs.about: Folders kept the same between this machine and others, with no cloud between them.
packs.label: Syncthing
